contexts.text: They are kept in the most intense desire to ascend into Heaven...
Abram went up out of Egypt = from scientific things... To go up is predicated of coming forth from lower things, which are scientific, to higher ones, which are heavenly.
When (the literal sense of the Word) is being read by man, especially by a little boy or girl; as it ascends, it becomes, by degrees, more beautiful and delightful...
Thus perishes the sense of the letter, as it ascends, and becomes spiritual, then celestial, and at last Divine. AC 1876. AC 3382.
These ideas were purified as they ascended higher; the ascents were represented by rejections.
God went up from Abraham = the Lord's entrance into the former state (of glorification).
(Rebecca) went up = elevation. Explained.

Hence it is that going up is predicated of going towards Jerusalem, but going down of going from Jerusalem; also from Jerusalem to Zion, and from Zion to Jerusalem... AC 4539:3, Illustrated, Explained.
To go up into the houses () = to destroy the goods that are of the will.
Isaac went up from thence to Beersheba = that the doctrine of faith was thence Divine.

Behold the Angels of God ascending and descending upon it = infinite and eternal communication, and conjunction thence derived. That from the lowest there is as it were an ascent, and afterwards, when the order is inverted, a descent, is evident from the signification of the Angels, which is something Divine of the Lord.
How the case is with this ascent and descent, may be evident from what has been said above. References.

Thus by those truths which were of man's infancy and childhood, the Angels of God as by a ladder ascended from earth to Heaven; but afterwards, by the truths that belong to his adult age, the Angels of God as by a ladder descend to the earth.

All goods and truths descend from the Lord, and ascend to Him; that is, that He is the First and the Last; for man is so created, that the Divine things of the Lord may descend through him to the ultimates of nature, and from the ultimates of nature ascend to Him. Fully Explained. AC 3726.

By the four sons of Jacob by Leah is described in the supreme sense the ascent from outward truth to inward good; but in the representative sense, the state of the Church... that it ascends to interior things according to this order... AC 3902.
What is treated of in the whole of this chapter; namely, ascent to the truths of love.
(Leah) stood still from bearing = ascent by a ladder from the earth even to Jehovah, or the Lord. Explained. AC 3939:end.
It is also this ascent which is signified by the ladder seen by Jacob...
Descent then follows, for man cannot descend until he has first ascended...
They shall go up with strong wing as eagles = to grow as to the understanding of truth, thus as to the Rational.
Every natural affection, when it ascends towards interior things, or towards Heaven, becomes milder, and at length is changed into a heavenly affection.

The Natural of man on one side communicates with the sensual things of the body, and on the other, with the rational things of the rational mind; by means of these intermediates there takes place as it were an ascent from sensual things which are of the body and open towards the world, to rational things which are of the rational mind and open towards Heaven; thus also a descent from them; namely, from Heaven to the world. This takes place in man alone. It is this ascent and descent which are treated of in the inward sense of these chapters.

Hence now it is, that by man alone is there a descent from the Heavens into the world, and an ascent from the world into the Heavens. It is the brain, and its interiors, by which the descent and ascent take place...
(The man who wrestled with Jacob said to him) Let me go, because the dawn goeth up = that temptation ceased when conjunction was at hand. AC 4300.
Arise, go up to Bethel = perception concerning the Divine Natural. To arise involves elevation... To go up = more towards interior things.

The reason to go up = towards interior things, is that interior things are what are called higher; therefore when advancement towards interior things is treated of in the inward sense, going up is spoken of, as from Egypt to the Land of Canaan; and in the Land of Canaan itself, toward the more interior parts. Illustrated. AC 5406:2.

God went up from above (Jacob) in the place in which he spake with him = the Divine in that state... for to go up involves elevation to interior things, and when it is predicated of the Lord... elevation to the Divine.
To go up involves elevation to good. Explained.
(Judah) went up to the shearers of his flock = something of elevation, to take counsel for the Church. To go up = to be elevated; namely, from what is exterior to what is interior. AC 4969.

Behold seven other kine coming up after them out of the river = falsities that are of the Natural, also in the boundary... That they were in the boundary is also manifest from the fact of its being said that they came up from the river; for to come up is predicated of advancement from what is exterior towards interior things. AC 5268.

In various places in the Word going up and going down are mentioned, as from one place to another, not because one place was in a higher situation than another, but because going up is predicated of going towards more interior or higher things, and going down, of going towards more exterior or lower things; that is, going up is predicated of going towards spiritual and celestial things, for these are interior, and are also believed to be higher; and going down, of going towards natural and earthly things, for these are exterior, and also, in appearance, lower.
Angelic thought and speech are... spiritual, (human thought and speech) are natural; the former falls into the latter when it descends, and the latter is turned into the former when it ascends...
When we go up to thy servant my father = elevation to spiritual good.
(Joseph's brethren) went up out of Egypt = departure from the scientific things of the Church. To go up thence = to depart... Here, by going up is signified going away.
I will also make thee come up in coming up = elevation afterwards. To come up = elevation.
Because thou wentest up on thy father's bed = because separate from the good of charity it has filthy conjunction.
There went up with him all the servants of Pharaoh = that it adjoined to itself the scientifics of the Natural. To go up with him = to adjoin to himself...
(Lest) they go up out of the land = that so the Church will be established. To go up = to be elevated; namely, towards the interior things that are of the Church.
To make him go up out of that land = that they should be elevated; namely, from the place and state where they are being infested by falsities. To make to go up = to be elevated.

And I say, I will make you go up from the affliction of Egypt = elevation and deliverance from infestation by false scientific things. To make to go up = elevation towards interior things. (References.) Elevation towards interior things is elevation from infestation by falsities to the truths and goods of faith; hence also to make to go up is deliverance. AC 8570.

It shall come up upon the land of Egypt = an outpouring into all things there. To come up = to be poured out. For the locust = what is false in the extremes, and its passing from the extremes towards the interiors is called coming up.
(A mixed multitude) went up with them = that were adjoined. To go up with them, when said concerning goods and truths, = that they were adjoined.
Truth from good is of such a nature, that it ascends to higher things, like a light body in the world.
The deposit of dew went up = the insinuation of truth. To go up, here, = to be dissipated, and thus not to appear in view.

Moses went up to God = truth from the Divine which is below Heaven, conjoining itself with Divine Truth which is in Heaven... To go up = to conjoin itself, for he who goes up to the Divine conjoins himself to it, as when mention is made of going up into Heaven, there is meant being conjoined with the Lord...
Take heed to yourselves coming up into the mount = no extension at all to the heavenly Societies that are in the love of good. To come up = to the Divine that is in a higher Heaven. AC 8803.
It sometimes happens that they who are in a lower Heaven strive to ascend into a higher Heaven. (The consequence.)
The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai = that they cannot elevate themselves to the Celestial Kingdom... To come up = to elevate.
Come up, thou and Aaron = conjunction with truth from the Divine, inward and outward. To come up, namely, to Jehovah = conjunction. AC 9373. AC 9380. AC 9415.
Thou shalt not go up by steps unto Mine altar = no elevation to interior things, which are celestial. To go up by steps = to elevate themselves to higher, or more interior things.
If those who are below Heaven desire to ascend into Heaven before they have been prepared, when they are elevated thither, they feel torment almost infernal, and appear to themselves as corpses...
The degrees of ascension from the people to the Lord are thus described...
He went up to the mount = elevation to Heaven. To go up = elevation towards interior things.

In making the lamps to ascend between the evenings, Aaron shall fumigate it = elevation even in an obscure state of love, when truth also is in its shade. To make the lamps ascend, or to kindle them = to enlighten by Divine Truth, and intelligence and wisdom thence derived.
To make to ascend = to elevate and augment the light of truth as much as possible.
To make the Sons of Israel come up from the land of Egypt = elevation from the natural or outward man to the inward or spiritual man, in order to be made a Church. AC 10409. AC 10421.
And now I will go up to Jehovah = elevation of the interiors to the Lord. To go up = elevation towards interior things.

Go, get up from hence, thou and the people whom thou hast made come up out of the land of Egypt, to the Land = that that nation will represent the Church, but that the Church will not be with it, because it cannot be elevated from outward things. To go up into the Land = to institute the Church... but here, only to represent it... therefore it is said Go, get up from hence... the people whom thou hast made come up, thus Moses... and not Jehovah. And in a following verse, I will not go up in the midst of thee... by which is signified that the Divine is not with them... To make to come up out of the land of Egypt = to be elevated from outward things to what is inward; but here, not to be elevated, because it is said that Moses made them come up, and not Jehovah. AC 10531. AC 10568. AC 10607.
In thy going up to see the faces of thy God three times in a year = when there is the Lord's presence in the truths of faith.

No one can ascend from a lower Heaven, nor can anyone descend from a higher Heaven. He who ascends from a lower Heaven is seized with anxiety even to pain, nor can he see those who are there, still less speak with them; and he who descends from a higher Heaven is deprived of his wisdom, falters in his voice, and is in despair. From experience. DLW 179.
The hypocrites... then quickly cast themselves down into the Hell where are their like, nor do they venture to ascend any more.
They first represented the Lord ascending from the sepulchre...
Afterwards I saw represented by them the descent of the Lord to the bound, and his ascent with the bound into Heaven...
Their learning does not ascend beyond such things as appear in the world before the eyes...

Since the Lord ascended into Heaven with the Divine and the Human united into one... it follows that His Human substance or essence is as His Divine one... This unition of the Father with the Son, or of the Divine with the Human, is meant in... If therefore ye shall see the Son of Man ascending up where He was before (); No one hath ascended into Heaven, except He who came down from Heaven (). Every man who is saved ascends into Heaven, not of himself, but still from the Lord. The Lord alone ascended of Himself.
The uses of all things that have been created, ascend through degrees from ultimates to man, and through man to God the Creator... General article.
There are three degrees of ascent in the natural world, and three degrees of ascent in the Spiritual World...
How man ascends; that is, is elevated, from the ultimate degree to the first.

An Angel of the Ultimate Heaven cannot ascend to the Angels of the Third Heaven, for if he does ascend and enter their Heaven, he falls as it were into a swoon, and his life wrestles as with death. Explained.
All perfections grow and ascend with degrees, and according to them. General article.
Of degrees of height it is said that they ascend, or descend...
These ascending and descending degrees, which are also called prior and posterior, also degrees of height, and discrete, are in their power in their ultimate. Explained.
These things are said generally, concerning the threefold ascent of the degrees of height...
The ascent of love according to degrees is not perceived by man, except very obscurely, but the ascent of wisdom, clearly, with those who know and see what wisdom is. Explained.

Come up hither = elevation of mind; for in the Spiritual World, the higher anyone ascends, into the purer light he comes, by which the understanding is, by degrees, opened; that is, the mind is elevated. AR 512. AE 263.
They ascended into heaven in a cloud = an uplifting into Heaven...
All who have been prepared for Heaven... see a way... which they enter, and ascend, and in the ascent there is a gate... TCR 622.
Then we went away from them, and behold steps before our eyes, by which we ascended, and returned above the earth...
They went up upon the breadth of the earth... = that being stirred up by the dragonists, they spurned all the truth of the Church... for to go up upon = to climb over and pass by, thus to spurn.
(Various Spirits give an account of their experience when attempting to ascend into Heaven.)
(Ten Spirits were chosen, and followed the Angel to Heaven. Their ascent described.)
The deliciousnesses of this love ascend and enter Heaven...
The deliciousnesses of marriage love ascend to the highest Heaven...

Upon true marriage love is inscribed this order, that it ascends and descends; it ascends from its first heat progressively towards their souls, with an effort to effect conjunctions there... but at the same moment at which that love ascends towards their souls, it also descends towards the body, and thereby clothes itself... Marriage love in its descent, is such as it is in the height to which it ascends; if it [ascends] high, it descends chaste; if it does not [ascend] high, it descends unchaste. Explained.

Into this lowest (degree) man is born, but he ascends into a higher one, which is called spiritual, by a life according to the truths of religion, and into the highest, by the marriage of love and wisdom.
Protection was then given to the Satans, and with the two Angels they ascended into Heaven...
I saw another Angel ascending from the rising of the sun = the Divine Love going forth from the Lord... To ascend thence = to go forth and proceed.
Come up hither = separation, and protection therefrom. AE 670.
The smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever = dense falsity encompassing them, and flowing forth from their loves continually... To ascend = to encompass and flow forth. Explained.
